capabilities.summary: Neutral SHA-256, HMAC-SHA256, constant-time compare, base64/base64url, hex, BLAKE3 text hash, canonical JSON and HMAC approval tokens
policyNotes: Declaration-only: apps call this crate instead of hand-rolling HMAC, constant-time compare, base64 or approval tokens.
Not a general cryptography suite: no encryption, signatures or key derivation.
